title: Chad Chops a Yam
lines: Dad and Chad walk to a shop.
They get a big yam and a bun.
At the hut, Chad chops the yam to chips.
Dad gets a pan hot and tips them in.
"Such a rich dish!" said his chum Meg.
Meg has much of it, and Chad has less.
A chip is on his chin.
"You can have the bun, Chad," said Meg.

questions.listenFor: Dad does. Chad chops, Dad cooks - two jobs, two people. Have them find the line with pan in it.

questions.ask: Why does Meg give Chad the bun?
questions.listenFor: She ate most of the chips and he only has one, on his chin. You want cause and effect, not just "she was nice."

questions.ask: Was that a kind thing for Meg to do? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer works. Listen for a reason from the story, like "yes, because Chad had hardly any left."
